step_1_decode_scenario_suffix.claim: The trailing '120' is the Splinters of Wrath option at its cap, not a duration and not R's rank-1 cooldown.
step_1_decode_scenario_suffix.why: Syndra's innate caps at 120 Splinters ('stacking up to 120 times'), 120 is the Transcendence threshold ('At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%'), and the cached audit records the module's option range explicitly as 'splinters option (0-120)'. R rank-1 cooldown also happens to be 120s but no cooldown-valued option exists.

step_2_what_casts_exist_at_120_splinters.claim: At splinters >= 40 Syndra's rotation contains TWO Dark Sphere casts, not one. 120 >= 40, so the second charge is live in this scenario.
step_2_what_casts_exist_at_120_splinters.wiki_text: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2. (data/champions.json > Syndra > abilities.Q > effects[1].description)
corroboration: data/champions.json > Syndra > abilities.Q > rechargeRate = [7,7,7,7,7] -- Q is a recharge/ammo ability, so a stocked charge carries zero remaining cooldown and is castable back-to-back.
data/champions.json > Syndra > abilities.Q > castTime = 'none' -- the two sphere casts occupy no exclusive cast time on the shared timeline.
data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json > atom 'stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo': 'stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)'.

data/champion-audit/batch-6.json > Syndra.module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] with note 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)' and notable_atoms 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)'.
data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json > Syndra.gap_summary: 'splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage'.

step_3_where_the_second_sphere_sits_in_t.claim: Both Dark Sphere casts precede W, E and R. The cast timeline is Q, Q2, W, E, R (5 casts).
reasons: Slot order recorded in the cached audit is [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] -- Q2 is declared immediately after Q, not appended after R (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json).

Apply-before-consume is forced by the wiki text: every other Syndra ability CONSUMES spheres. W: 'Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere ... within 500 units'. E: 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units ... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds'. R: 'Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones'. Casting the stocked sphere after R would strictly waste it, so no correct rotation places Q2 last.

The repo's own rotation doctrine states the same principle and names the default fallback: 'src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R)' and rotations must 'respect cooldowns' with setup abilities applied before consumers (data/worklists/f2-task.md).

timing_check_against_math_foundations.quoted_rule: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`) ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order. (docs/math-foundations.md, section 1.1)
timing_check_against_math_foundations.application: At fight start every Syndra slot is off cooldown and the second Dark Sphere is stocked, so the greedy shared-timeline scheduler emits the casts in cast-order with no gating: Q at t=0 (castTime none), Q2 immediately after (stocked charge, remaining cooldown 0, castTime none), then W (castTime none), then E (castTime 0.25s), then R (castTime 0.25s). Cast times taken from data/champions.json > Syndra > abilities.*.castTime. No cooldown (Q 7s, W 12/11/10/9/8s, E 15s, R 120/100/80s) is reached inside this opening rotation, so no ability repeats and the timeline is exactly the cast order.

step_4_index_arithmetic.diagnosis_of_the_old_value: The old timeline [Q, W, E, R] is a 4-cast rotation that omits the stocked second Dark Sphere. That omission is only correct below 40 Splinters; this scenario pins splinters=120. Inserting the one wiki-mandated extra cast before the consumers shifts every later slot by one, moving E from index 2 to index 3 and R from index 3 to index 4 -- exactly the observed change. The change is a single insertion, not a reordering or a deletion: a deletion would have shortened the list rather than substituting E at index 3.

independent_computation.robustness_note: The scenario's explicit 'custom' cast order is scenario input and is not present anywhere under data/ (grep for 'syndra_custom_order' / 'custom_order' over the exported tree returns nothing in data/, and data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json contains no Syndra scenario), so the base order was not read directly. The conclusion does not depend on it: the observed old value pins the base tail as (..., E at index 2, R at index 3), and the wiki-mandated Q2 insertion -- which must land before the sphere consumers W/E/R -- shifts that E to index 3 for ANY base order with Q ahead of E. Under the repo's documented default order Q,W,E,R the result is the same: [Q, Q2, W, E, R].

conclusion: At splinters = 120 the cached wiki text requires a second stocked Dark Sphere cast, and every other Syndra ability consumes Dark Spheres, so both Q casts open the rotation. The 4th cast (index 3) of the shared-timeline rotation is therefore E, with R displaced to index 4. The new value E is correct; the old value R came from a rotation that silently dropped the 40-splinter stocked charge.
